source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Once both armies are deployed, you can redeploy up to 3 of your **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units, and any of them may go into **Strategic Reserves** instead, however many units are already there. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** model may take it.

effects.when: after both players have deployed their armies

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Orbital Assault Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
